We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!    This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.  Blue Origin is seeking a skilled and experienced Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) Engineer to join our elite team of experts on the Engineering Center of Excellence Electromagnetics team. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on the future of space exploration by ensuring top-level Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), lightning, and Radio Frequency (RF) integration and architecture for our advanced electrical and electronic systems. Your expertise will be crucial in executing rigorous EMI/EMC testing, and developing robust verification strategies to ensure safe and repeatable spaceflight of our cutting-edge aerospace systems. descriptions.915005020659918: Location: Mount Pleasant, Pennsylvania, United States of America Job ID: R0145020 Date Posted: 2026-09-13 Company Name: HITACHI ENERGY USA INC Profession (Job Category): Engineering & Science Job Schedule:  Full time Remote: Yes Job Description: The Opportunity Are you ready to work on some of the most critical power infrastructure in North America? Join Hitachi Energy as a Field Service Engineer, where your expertise will help keep electrical transmission systems operating safely, reliably, and efficiently. In this highly visible role, you will travel to customer sites across the United States and support the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, repair, and modernization of high-voltage circuit breakers and related equipment up to 800kV. You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers maximize equipment performance, minimize downtime, and maintain dependable power delivery. This is a 100% remote, field-based opportunity that offers extensive travel, hands-on technical challenges, and continuous learning. From day one, you'll receive comprehensive technical training and certification, company-provided equipment, travel expense coverage, competitive compensation with overtime eligibility, annual bonus opportunities, and industry-leading benefits. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and making a meaningful impact on the electric power industry, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding long-term career with a global technology leader. How You'll Make an Impact Perform commissioning, troubleshooting, repair, and modification of High Voltage circuit breakers and other High Voltage equipment up to 800kV. Dependent on job level, perform simple to complex field service operations that typically require strong technical knowledge and skills with some supervision. Conduct tests that require selection and adaptation, or modification of equipment and procedures. Compile and evaluate data to determine and resolve operating problems or malfunctions. Troubleshoot equipment issues and failures and take measures to prevent and repair. Identify electrical or mechanical problems and determine the corrective action. Generate reports following the performance of field service assignments, including compilation of daily activities, photos, and test data. Communicate effectively with customers, field teams, and engineering support to provide technical up-dates, explain findings, and ensure alignment on work scope and safety requirements. Collaborate with internal teams and site personnel to support commissioning activities, outage schedules, and successful project execution. Adhere to company safety policies and customer site safety requirements while following applicable reg-ula tory standards and operating procedures.  Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your Background Minimum of an Associate degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or related technical discipline is strongly preferred. Direct hands-on experience with High Voltage circuit breakers or within an electrical substation environment strongly preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered and may include maintenance, troubleshooting, testing, installation, repair, or commissioning of complex mechanical, electrical, electromechanical, aerospace, military, industrial, manufacturing, power generation, or transportation systems. Mechanical and electrical aptitudes with demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical and mechanical issues using hand tools, voltage multimeters, and specialized test equipment to ensure equipment reliability and system performance.
